fields.Name: T130 - Action Explorer View Mode Toggle
fields.Description: Three distinct render branches (card-grid / list-view / compact-view) driven by mj-view-toggle in the bespoke explorer — a code path that no generic grid exercises.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Actions' application, then open the 'Explorer' nav item. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. The Action Explorer shows a view-mode toggle in the toolbar with three options (Card / List / Compact). Click through the toggle options and verify the action list re-renders in a visibly different layout for each mode (card grid vs. row list vs. dense compact list). Seeing the layout change when you switch modes is success — the list may be empty, in which case a clear empty-state is acceptable.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Explorer toolbar shows a view-mode toggle with card / list / compact options
Switching between at least two modes visibly changes the action list layout (grid vs. list rows) OR a valid empty-state renders consistently
The selected toggle option shows an active/selected indicator after clicking
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
